facts.text: `project_context` is documented as a read-only hybrid search client for Agent-MCP `ask_project_rag` on spark, default `http://100.84.178.124:8090`. The spark `embeddinggemma` unit serves `google/embeddinggemma-2` (768d) at `127.0.0.1:8200`.
The repository declares the Agent-MCP submodule `vendor/agent-mcp`, sourced from `https://github.com/rinadelph/Agent-MCP.git`, in `.gitmodules`.

TaskManage evidence paths resolve only against the workspace root, linked worktrees, and host `evidenceRoots`. Any other path, such as a session file outside those roots, fails with `outside_allowed_roots`.

`docs/reference/project-findings.md` holds reviewed facts promoted from memory candidates under stable `F-NNNN` headings. Each fact is re-checked against current code, and a memory record's session-file evidence is not accepted because TaskManage cannot resolve it.
